tagline: Precision Cuts. Sharp Fades. A Proper Chair Experience.
businessDescription: Built for Perth. Next Level is a modern luxury barbershop for clean cuts, confident fades, and proper conversation. We blend classic barbering technique with a sharp, current point of view, delivering an experience that feels as good as the finish looks.

services.name: Classic Haircut
services.description: A timeless cut tailored to your face, style, and skull anatomy. Finished with hot towel neck shave.

services.name: Skin Fade
services.description: Seamless transition from foil shaver down to skin, foil-blended and finished with precision clipper work.

services.name: Beard Sculpt & Razor Edge
services.description: Sculpt, debulk, and line up the beard with Japanese razor blade finishing and organic beard elixir.

services.name: The Executive: Cut & Beard
services.description: Our signature combination: tailored haircut, detailed beard shaping, and steam towel relaxation.

services.name: Traditional Hot Towel Shave
services.description: Essential eucalyptus prep oil, dual warm towel infusion, and traditional straight razor shave.

services.name: Hair Styling & Texture Finish
services.description: Wash, blow-dry sculpt, and matte clay or pomade texturing for events and meetings.

services.name: Young Gentleman's Cut
services.description: Patient, comfortable styling for younger clients aged 12 and under.

services.name: Head Shave & Polish
services.description: Hot foam straight razor scalp shave followed by soothing menthol toner and scalp moisture treatment.

packages.name: The Silver Groom
packages.description: Refined fundamental grooming essentials executed with razor-sharp precision.

packages.name: The Gold Reserve
packages.description: The full master barber chair ritual: meticulous cut, straight razor beard sculpt, and aromatic steam treatment.

reviews.name: Abu Omar
